Each version is a persona-lens through which the section is curated: Builder (ship mode), Musician (trumpet/jazz/AMT), Researcher (papers/eval), Creative Coder (art/shaders/3D), Director (meta-curator spanning all 30 of Kai's interests). Switch versions with the pill row above the hub grid. All links verified Aug 12 2026.

researcher.tagline: Reading + eval — the weekly research cadence

items.text: Read MuScriptor (arXiv 2401.16158) end-to-end — the music-XML + AMT paper most relevant to my project
Skim AudioLDM 2 (arXiv 2308.09836) — text-to-audio + music + sound, holistic generation

Compare 3 agent frameworks on a fixed 3-step task (LangGraph vs crewAI vs autogen) — pick the winner for next sprint

creative.tagline: Sketch + shader + render — the visual-software day

WebGL + camera input: silhouette → A4 print-quality SVG (one line art per frame)
